name: context-menu-31
description: Store admin order rows that mark orders shipped, print labels, or issue refunds.

files.content:
"use client" import * as React from "react" import { Printer as PrinterIcon, Truck as TruckIcon, Undo as UndoIcon, User as UserIcon, } from "@designali/icons" import { Badge } from "@workspace/ui/components/badge" import { ContextMenu, ContextMenuContent, ContextMenuGroup, ContextMenuItem, ContextMenuLabel, ContextMenuSeparator, ContextMenuTrigger, } from "@workspace/ui/components/context-menu" const initialOrders = [ { id: "#48211", customer: "Designali Templates", total: "$84.00", status: "Unfulfilled", }, { id: "#48212", customer: "Designali Blocks", total: "$129.50", status: "Shipped" }, { id: "#48213", customer: "Icons Pro", total: "$42.25", status: "Unfulfilled", }, ] export default function OrderFulfillmentMenu() { const [orders, setOrders] = React.useState(initialOrders) const setStatus = (id: string, status: string) => setOrders((list) => list.map((o) => (o.id === id ? { ...o, status } : o))) return (
{orders.map((order) => ( {order.id} {order.customer} {order.total} {order.status} Order {order.id} setStatus(order.id, "Shipped")} > Mark as shipped Print shipping label View customer setStatus(order.id, "Refunded")} > Refund order ))}
) }
